commands.build:
rtk proxy python -X utf8 -c '
import tempfile,shutil,subprocess,json,hashlib,sys
from pathlib import Path
root=Path.cwd()
result={}
for name,repo in [("nexus",root),("connector",root.parent/"okto-nexus-connector")]:
    stage=Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix="okto-r4-startup-"+name+"-build-"))
    output=Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix="okto-r4-startup-"+name+"-wheel-"))
    shutil.copytree(repo/"src",stage/"src",ignore=shutil.ignore_patterns("__pycache__","*.egg-info"))
    for filename in ["pyproject.toml","README.md","LICENSE"]:
        if (repo/filename).exists(): shutil.copy2(repo/filename,stage/filename)
    command=[sys.executable,"-m","pip","wheel","--no-deps","--no-build-isolation","--wheel-dir",str(output),str(stage)]
    run=subprocess.run(command,text=True,capture_output=True)
    (output/"build.log").write_text(run.stdout+"\n"+run.stderr,encoding="utf-8")
    if run.returncode: print((run.stdout+"\n"+run.stderr)[-6000:]); raise SystemExit(run.returncode)
    wheel=next(output.glob("*.whl"))
    result[name]={"stage":str(stage),"wheel":str(wheel),"sha256":hashlib.sha256(wheel.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),"build_log":str(output/"build.log"),"command":command}
metadata=Path(tempfile.gettempdir())/"r4-startup-wheels.json"
metadata.write_text(json.dumps(result,indent=2)+"\n",encoding="utf-8")
print(json.dumps(result,indent=2))
'
